title: In-Database Vector RAG with SQLite-Vec, LlamaIndex, and Hybrid Tantivy BM25 Dispatch
summary: Architectural distillation of paperless_ai in Paperless-NGX (v3.1.3). Documents zero-external-dependency vector retrieval using the sqlite-vec extension (llmindex.db), LlamaIndex node chunking (512 output / 200 overlap), dual-layer hybrid search combining Tantivy lexical BM25 with dense semantic vector embeddings, and streaming chat reference citation protocols.

references.description: Chunking, embedding, and index building pipelines
Streaming RAG chat engine and reference resolution
Tantivy full-text search backend via whoosh-compat

claims.claim: paperless_ai embeds documents into a dedicated SQLite database (llmindex.db) using the sqlite-vec C extension, eliminating the need for standalone vector database microservices.
Documents are split into overlapping chunks with RAG_NUM_OUTPUT=512 and RAG_CHUNK_OVERLAP=200, streaming through QuerySetStream with _INDEX_STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE=1000 to bound memory.
The streaming chat endpoint (/api/documents/chat/) yields Server-Sent Events with delimited metadata (__PAPERLESS_CHAT_METADATA__) containing exact document citations and confidence bounds.
